prompts.blue:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a polished landscape brand direction board for the macOS developer app DevDock, direction 01 / Midnight. This is one cohesive presentation asset used to select a palette before final export.
Create a professional identity combining minimal developer-tool precision with native macOS polish. The exact product name is "DevDock", capital D in both words, one word.
Design ONE original, simple, memorable DD/dock symbol: two interlocking rounded bracket-like D forms with a generous central port-shaped negative space. Strong silhouette, very few elements, generous negative space; it must remain recognizable as a solid monochrome macOS menu-bar template glyph at 16–22 pixels. Use precisely the same symbol in every application on the board.
Palette: deep midnight navy #101827, electric blue #4B8DFF, restrained teal #5AE0CA, warm white #F4F7FB. No purple.
Composition: sophisticated, spacious, carefully aligned landscape 3:2 brand presentation. Top half: a wide GitHub repository banner, with the symbol and beautifully kerned DevDock wordmark, and only the small functional descriptor "Ports · Processes · Containers". Bottom half: the same symbol in a premium macOS rounded-square app icon with subtle controlled depth and a tiny bevel, alongside a flat transparent-background logo demonstration and two realistic very small menu-bar strips, light and dark, using the same monochrome glyph. Clearly show how all assets match, not separate unrelated logos.
Typography: clean contemporary neo-grotesk, optical kerning, medium weight, precision comparable to a mature professional macOS tool.
Small English labels may read "01 / Midnight", "GitHub", "App icon", "Menu bar". Exact spelling, no extra slogans. Avoid mock terminal data, security promises, stock illustrations, Docker whale, Apple logo, shields, padlocks, neon glow, excessive gradients, glossy plastic, fake device photographs, excessive ornament, fine lines that disappear when small, watermarks. Product-ready visual identity, exceptionally clean and good looking.

Create the matching second palette option for the SAME DevDock identity. Preserve the EXACT symbol geometry, wordmark typography, spacing, dimensions, board layout, app-icon shape, banner composition and menu-bar glyphs. This is a coordinated palette study, not a redesign.

The symbol's two interlocking parts should use amber and pale gold, and the app icon background graphite, with the same subtle native macOS depth.
Change the top-left label verbatim to "02 / Amber". Retain exact text "DevDock", "Ports · Processes · Containers", "GitHub", "App icon", "Menu bar".
In the bottom color swatch labels use only these words: "Graphite", "Amber", "Pale gold", "Ivory" instead of hex codes, to keep the board clean. The menu-bar strips must retain solid dark/light template glyphs that match the same symbol. Preserve all other elements. No additional slogans, symbols, code, logos or watermarks.
prompts.mono:
Use case: logo-brand.
Input image: the DevDock "01 / Midnight" brand direction board is the edit target and identity reference.
Create palette option 03 for the exact SAME DevDock identity. Preserve the EXACT interlocking symbol geometry, wordmark typography, optical kerning, spacing, board layout, macOS app-icon shape, banner composition and menu-bar glyphs. This is a palette edit, not a new logo.
Palette: predominantly near-black #111214, clean white #F7F7F5, refined silver #C6CBCF, with a single very restrained cool sage accent #91AEA6. The main two-part mark is white and silver in the banner; the sage accent should be a small controlled detail or a subtle edge, never a dominant green identity. App icon is near-black with the same mark in white and silver, subtle macOS-native depth and a tiny bevel. The overall impression is calm, premium, timeless monochrome software branding.
Change the top-left label verbatim to "03 / Monochrome". Retain exact text "DevDock", "Ports · Processes · Containers", "GitHub", "App icon", "Menu bar". Bottom swatch labels must be "Carbon", "White", "Silver", "Sage". Keep light/dark menu-bar strips with solid template glyphs matching the same mark.
Keep all elements coordinated. No new shapes, altered monograms, extra slogans, security promises, stock illustrations, unrelated logos or watermarks.
prompts.appicon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Input image: DevDock Midnight brand board, approved identity and app icon reference.
Create ONE final production macOS application icon, square 1024 by 1024 pixels, using EXACTLY the app icon from the board's bottom-left panel. Preserve the original two-part interlocking DevDock symbol geometry, electric blue left form and teal right form, dark midnight navy rounded-square body, subtle premium macOS bevel and controlled depth. The symbol must match the banner's mark.
Output only the single icon, centered head-on, with no perspective, no wordmark, no text, no labels, no board, no extra icons, no UI.
Use standard macOS app-icon canvas padding: the rounded-square body occupies about 82% of the full square canvas, centered, with modest soft shadow contained within the canvas. The surrounding canvas outside the rounded square must be genuinely transparent, not white and not a checkerboard pattern. Clean professional edges, generous central negative space, readable at 32 pixels, no shiny plastic or excess glow.
prompts.logo:
Use case: logo-brand.
Input image: approved DevDock Midnight brand board, identity reference and extraction target.
Create one final horizontal transparent DevDock logo lockup, suitable for GitHub README and website use.
Retain EXACTLY the approved custom two-part interlocking rounded D/dock symbol, electric blue #4B8DFF left form and teal #5AE0CA right form, with the exact same proportions and negative space as the board. To its right set the exact word "DevDock" in the same clean, beautifully kerned neo-grotesk wordmark, using near-white #F4F7FB for a dark-background version.
Output only the symbol and wordmark on a genuinely transparent background. Flat, crisp, vector-like edges with no shadow, no 3D, no bevel, no squircle, no frame, no checkerboard texture, no labels, no swatches, no extra text, no watermark. Wide landscape 3:1 composition, generous clear space around the lockup, strong clarity at small sizes. The spelling must be precisely DevDock.
prompts.banner:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Input image: approved DevDock Midnight brand board, identity and banner reference.
Create ONE finished GitHub repository/social-preview banner as a standalone wide 2:1 image, around 1536 by 768 pixels. Retain the exact approved interlocking blue/teal DevDock mark and precise DevDock wordmark from the top half of the reference. Make it an impeccably polished, restrained developer-tool banner.
Deep midnight navy backdrop, electric blue and teal softly sculpted abstract edge forms, lots of balanced negative space, a clear large symbol and the exact text "DevDock". The only secondary line is "Ports · Processes · Containers". Keep all important content within a generous central safe area for GitHub crop variations. No board title, no "01 / Midnight", no GitHub label, no color swatches, no app-icon panel, no mock menu bar, no checkerboard, no transparent extraction, no code screenshot, no other text, no security promises, no watermark. Use the approved mark consistently, without new geometry.
